design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — preowned_repossession_recovery task 1 (Marcus Lindqvist, discretionary reinstatement). Revised in rework rounds 2 and 3.

1. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 5, 4]}. Statement storage 4, redemption quote 4, sale notice 5, reinstatement funds 4.

2. Why this is a good test. The customer asks only to get his truck back by catching the loan up. The reinstatement policy takes funds only after a notice of intent to sell for the current repossession is on the account (the contract shows no mailing date) and fixes the amount only after storage billed for the current repossession on the statement date is on the account (none: the storage rows on record are the 2025 recovery's). The notice policy does not mail until a redemption quote dated the mailing date stands (none), and the redemption figure is not stated until the same storage is on the account. The notice is independently owed: repossession Wednesday 2026-10-14, due within three business days (Thursday, Friday, Monday 2026-10-19), and it is Saturday 2026-10-17. Order storage -> quote -> notice -> reinstatement; 17 factor ladders over a 43-row ledger and a retail contract in another product.

3. World choice (F-5). The contract (Tier 1+, TX) records no state reinstatement period, so this reinstatement is one the company grants at its discretion (reinstatements_used 1 is below the Tier 1+ maximum of 2), and the company's published discretionary terms apply: installments paid ahead on a repeat reinstatement, a relationship reserve while another Kestrel account is past due but under the 30-day limit at which the reinstatement is not offered at all, and a returned-payment reserve priced at the policy's own share. A reinstatement a recorded state period grants is the customer's right and is collected as past-due installments plus late charges and repossession and storage expenses only (returned-payment and extension fees left out; no reserve, no installment ahead) — a plain branch of the rule, not reached in this world.

4. Scope. Claimed: preowned_ext_release_storage_charge (bill_lot_storage_d761f3de), preowned_ext_redemption_quote (quote_redemption_amount_aa560e9a), preowned_ext_sale_notice_schedule (mail_sale_notice_3d21c42f), preowned_ext_reinstatement_funds (remit_reinstatement_funds_62601f54, owner=user). The 2026 transport charge is already booked (190.00 dated the 2026-10-15 lot intake, matching the transport schedule: 6 search days -> tier fee 135.00, second recovery +30.00, Wednesday, 1 yard night 25.00), so no task-0 obligation is lit.

5. Problem-tree card.
 R <- S (value_input, fees_due, state, affirmative): "The reinstatement amount is fixed only after the account carries a storage charge billed for the current repossession on the statement date." Skip -> 6418.22 instead of 6482.22.
 Q <- S (value_input, fees_due, state, negated): "The redemption figure is not stated until the account carries a storage charge billed for the current repossession on the quote date." Skip -> 28254.27 instead of 28430.27.
 N <- Q (state_gate, state, negated): "The notice of intent to sell is not mailed until a redemption quote dated the mailing date stands on the account." Only quote_redemption_amount_aa560e9a writes redemption-purpose quotes.
 R <- N (state_gate, state, affirmative): "Reinstatement funds are taken only after a notice of intent to sell for the current repossession is on the account." Only mail_sale_notice_3d21c42f writes such a notice and the mailing date.
 Storage is now owed whenever an amount to get the vehicle back must be stated, so the notice chain never bottoms out in a customer request (P-1). Topological order S -> Q -> N -> R is unique. The persona names no prerequisite; the four tool bodies validate nothing.

6. Base-invariant card. Storage: repossession_charges.expense_status (repossessed allowed). Quote: payoff_and_refunds.quote_status. Notice: repossession_assignment.notice_status; mailing within 3 business days of 2026-10-14. Reinstatement: payment_posting.payable_status; reinstatement_window (no state period: Tier 1+ window 21 days counted from the day after 2026-10-14, last timely day 2026-11-04 inclusive; funds post Monday 2026-10-19, day 5; before the 2026-11-23 sale set at step 12); reinstatement_count (1 below the Tier 1+ maximum 2); reinstatement_relationship (retail 10 days past due, lease and balloon closed at 0 — all under 30). Bankruptcy none.

7. Business-object card. Contract 3108815204 (2023 Kestrel Ironhide 2500 HD Crew Cab LT). Current-recovery rows: agency fee 2026-10-14, condition report and transport charge 2026-10-15 (lot intake). History: 2025 recovery (agency fee 2025-05-16, condition report and transport and redemption quote and notice and a zero storage charge 2025-05-19, zero storage charge and the wire reinstatement payment 2025-05-22 with its fee payment), the June 2026 returned autopay and its 25.00 fee and the 2026-06-18 replacement, three 2026 late charges, 22 installment payments. Excluded by the rules' words: 2025 condition reports and storage charges (not the most recent), the 2025 quote and notice (not dated the mailing date / not for the current repossession).

8. Factor card (Step 5 run).
 Storage 50.00 (all-baseline 0.00): free days 0 (involuntary + reinstatement payment; multi-source; -> 0.00); lot_intake_anchor 2 days from the day after the 2026-10-15 intake (-> 75.00); window rate 15.00 (-> 56.00); oversize 10.00 (-> 30.00).
 Redemption quote 28430.27 (all-baseline 27763.59): interest and good-through to 2026-11-04 (139 days; -> 28388.59); reconditioning 200.00 (-> 28230.27); projected storage 18 days x 25.00 billed daily amount (-> 27980.27); fee concession 25.00 (-> 28455.27).
 Sale notice 37 days (all-baseline 16): the schedules give 36 days, a Sunday, moved to Monday 2026-11-23; company-window anchor 19 (-> 33); established 5 (-> 31); retail relationship 3 (cross-difficulty; -> 33); heavy preparation 7 (-> 30, Sunday moved to Monday); lot transfer 2 (-> 34).
 Reinstatement 6482.22 (all-baseline 4145.76): pay-ahead 2 (98 days >= 90; -> 4819.34); relationship reserve method: half of this contract's installment 415.72 (cross-difficulty retail, 10 < 15; 15-29 days would add the retail contract's own past-due amount to half this installment; -> 6066.50); returned reserve 207.86 (-> 6274.36); posting days 2 (Saturday; parameter; each priced at the vehicle's own billed daily amount 25.00, whatever the call day; -> 6432.22).
 Near-misses: 15 days on the retail contract would add its own past-due amount to half this contract's installment; the closed lease and balloon contract; 2025 storage rows; the 2025 notice.

9. Posting (P-5). The reinstatement tool posts on the posting date (Monday for Saturday funds) in the base allocation order: accrued interest 06-19..10-19, principal up to the past-due amount, fees, remainder to principal; whole installments covered advance next_due_date (2026-07-10 -> 2027-01-10) and payments_made_count; interest_paid_to_date becomes the posting date. The rule states exactly this.

10. Verification (scratch harness importing check_compute.build_env/eval_compute):
 S {'expected': 50.0, 'repeat_recovery_free_days': 0.0, 'lot_intake_anchor': 75.0, 'reinstatement_period_rate': 56.0, 'oversize_bay': 30.0, 'ALL_BASELINE': 0.0}
 Q {'expected': 28430.27, 'redemption_interest_end': 28388.59, 'reconditioning_estimate': 28230.27, 'projected_lot_storage': 27980.27, 'payoff_fee_concession': 28455.27, 'ALL_BASELINE': 27763.59}
 N {'expected': 37, 'reinstatement_right_anchor': 33, 'established_customer_days': 31, 'retail_relationship_days': 33, 'heavy_vehicle_preparation': 30, 'auction_transfer_days': 34, 'ALL_BASELINE': 16}
 R {'expected': 6482.22, 'second_reinstatement_pay_ahead': 4819.34, 'retail_relationship_reserve': 6066.5, 'returned_payment_reserve': 6274.36, 'weekend_posting_days': 6432.22, 'ALL_BASELINE': 4145.76}
 skip S -> Q 28254.27 ; skip S -> R 6418.22. No figure sits on an exact half cent.

11. Persona. Saturday call; volunteers only the goal (truck back by catching up, not paying off) and his phone; SSN last four and DOB when asked; the wife's Halcyon loan "a week or so behind" only if asked (10 days past due); accepts anything done first; wires exactly the amount when handed the tool; ends when told the contract is reinstated and when he can pick up the truck (it is released once the funds post, Monday).

12. Standard solution: find_customers -> verify -> find_preowned_contracts -> find_preowned_transactions -> find_retail_contracts -> find_lease_contracts -> find_balloon_contracts -> bill storage 50.00 / 2 days -> redemption quote 28430.27 good 18 days -> mail notice, 37 days (sale Monday 2026-11-23) -> hand over; customer wires 6482.22.

13. Edge probes: no retail contract -> relationship days 0 and reserve 0; two active retail contracts -> the first listed is read (rule says so); retail at 15 days -> the reserve becomes half this contract's installment plus the retail contract's own past-due amount; recorded state period running -> statutory branch (no reserves, no pay-ahead, returned-payment and extension fees left out) and the quote's fee concession leaves out the same fees; no condition report -> stored days from the day after repossession, no projected storage, no transfer days; Sunday statement -> one posting day at the same billed daily amount; a most recent storage charge covering no billable day, or none on record -> posting days and projected days priced at the tier storage fee; a schedule date on a Saturday or Sunday -> moved to the Monday.

14. Draft recomputation from visible context: reinstatement rule -> waits on the notice (none) and on storage through today (none) -> notice rule -> waits on a redemption quote dated today (none) -> quote rule -> waits on the same storage -> storage tiers from the posting record, the reinstatement window and the vehicle description -> 50.00/2 days; then the quote, the notice days and the reinstatement as traced. Same objects, order and figures as gold.


15. Round-3 seed realism. The 2025-05-19 redemption quote carries the redemption-quote schedule's amount (39414.76) and the window-end good-through 2025-06-06. The contract is a Kestrel make sold without Certified Pre-Owned status, so 7.24% is the Tier 1+ 49-60 band rate with no reduction. The retail contract (Tier 1, 72 months) carries the Tier 1 61-72 rate 7.24% and an installment of 512.87 amortised at it; the balloon contract (Tier 2, 36 months) carries 7.24% with a 50% balloon of 16700.00; the closed 2019 lease follows the lease disclosure formula (Tier 2 money factor 0.00195, residual 58% of MSRP, base payment 373.92).
user_scenario:
You are Marcus Lindqvist, thirty-nine, a self-employed drywall contractor in Plano, Texas. Kestrel repossessed your work truck, a 2023 Kestrel Ironhide 2500 HD you finance with them, on Wednesday, and without it you cannot get to jobs. You are calling on Saturday morning, a little embarrassed and in a hurry, because a client finally paid you and you want the truck back by catching the loan up, not by paying the whole loan off; you want to reinstate the contract and keep making the monthly payments. You do not know what you owe to get it back and you want the desk to tell you.

To be found you give your phone number, 3135530718. If the agent needs more to confirm who you are, you give the last four of your Social Security number, 3926, and your date of birth, 1986-09-03; you do not volunteer your email or ZIP unless asked. You do not have the account number handy. If the agent asks about other accounts, you say you also have a newer Kestrel car loan on your wife's Halcyon and you think that one is a week or so behind; you do not know the exact figure.

You are fine with the agent recording or sending whatever has to go on the account on their side before they can give you the number, and if they tell you something has to happen first you say "okay, do what you need to do" and wait. You will send the money today by bank wire from your credit union account, and when the agent gives you the amount and hands the payment over to you, you send the wire yourself for exactly that amount and read back the confirmation if asked. If the amount is more than you expected, you grumble that it is a lot more than the payments you missed but you pay it, because you need the truck. When the agent tells you the contract is reinstated and when you can pick the truck up, you say thanks and hang up.
